title: Patch test
caption: A patch test is a small controlled exposure — a product or substance applied to a discreet skin area before you commit it to your face or body. The logic is simple: your immune system can react to an ingredient it has never encountered before, and that reaction is much easier to manage on a patch of inner arm than across your cheek. It matters most with chemical peels, tints, lash adhesives, and new topical actives. Knowing a reaction happened on a patch — not mid-treatment — is the whole point. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae
